# Register reference {#registers}

This appendix lists the registers of the control modules of LiteJESD204, one bank per
TX or RX core, JESD204B and JESD204C. It is generated from the register definitions of
the gateware, elaborated on a reference design for the KC705 platform with stand-in
PHYs, without running an FPGA toolchain: the design is elaborated only, never built or
run on hardware. Offsets are in bytes from the base of the bank; the base addresses
depend on the SoC and are in the `csr.csv` of a build. A LiteX SoC names the banks
after the attributes that hold the control modules, `jesd204b_tx`, `jesd204b_rx`,
`jesd204c_tx` and `jesd204c_rx` in this design.

| Configuration | Target and options |
|------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| `kc705_stand_in` | `xilinx_kc705` `L=4 M=4 F=2 S=1 K=32 N=N'=16` `E=1 (204C)` `with_lane_status=True (204B RX)` |

Access is `rw` for a register written by software (`CSRStorage`, or a `CSRStatus` that
software also writes, such as event pending bits cleared by writing 1), `ro` for a status
(`CSRStatus`) and `wo` for a write-only strobe (`CSR`). The reset value of a `CSRStorage`
register ends its description. A register wider than 32 bits takes several
32-bit words of the bus, most significant word first. Software uses these names through the `csr.csv` or `csr.h` of the build, so it rarely
needs the offsets. The reset value of `lmfc` is given in the notes of each bank.

## JESD204B TX control {#reg-jesd204b-tx}

Defined by `LiteJESD204BCoreControl` (`litejesd204/core.py`).

One `LiteJESD204BCoreControl` per core; the bank takes the name of the attribute that
holds it. On a TX core, `sync_n` is the SYNC~ level received from the converter, after
the polarity of `register_jsync`: 0 is a synchronization request. `skew_fifo` and
`stpl_errors` are not driven on TX and read 0; `ilas_check_disable` has no effect.

The flags and levels cross from the link clock to the system clock through `MultiReg`
synchronizers, bit by bit, so a level read while it changes can be inconsistent; the
32-bit `stpl_errors` crosses with a `BusSynchronizer` handshake and always reads a
value the counter had. The reset value of `lmfc` is the LMFC load of the core, 5 on TX
([TX and RX cores](#cores)).

Bank `jesd204b_tx`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `control` | `0x0000` | 9 | rw | See the fields below. Reset `0x0`. |
| `status` | `0x0004` | 16 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `stpl_enable` | `0x0008` | 1 | rw | 1: the STPL generator (TX) or checker (RX) replaces the converter port. Reset `0x0`. |
| `stpl_errors` | `0x000c` | 32 | ro | STPL test errors: link clocks with mismatching samples while STPL is enabled and the core ready, cleared when STPL is enabled (``RX only``). |
| `lmfc` | `0x0010` | 4 | rw | LMFC reload value on SYSREF rising edge. Reset `0x5`. |

Fields of `control`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `enable` | 0 | 1: links out of reset, the core runs. 0: links held in reset. |
| `ilas_check_` `disable` | 8 | 1: the RX links accept an ILAS that differs from the expected one. No effect on a TX core. |

Fields of `status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `ready` | 0 | 1: every link of the core is synchronized and carries data. |
| `sync_n` | 1 | JESD ``SYNC~`` status. |
| `skew_fifo` | 15:8 | JESD Skew FIFO level (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |

## JESD204B RX control {#reg-jesd204b-rx}

Defined by `LiteJESD204BCoreControl` (`litejesd204/core.py`).

Same class as the TX bank. On an RX core, `sync_n` is the SYNC~ level the core drives
towards the converter, before the polarity of `register_jsync`, and `ready` is updated
at each LMFC zero only. `skew_fifo` is the level of the skew FIFO of lane 0. The
reset value of `lmfc` is the RX load, `lmfc_cycles - 5`: 11 here, with 16 link clocks
per multiframe.

`skew_levels`, `skew_overflows` and `lane_align` exist only with
`with_lane_status=True`. They report lanes 0 to 3, except `skew_overflows`,
which reports lanes 0 to 7. The sticky flags clear when the lane leaves its data
phase. `stpl_errors` counts the link clock cycles in which at least one sample
differs from the pattern, only while `stpl_enable` is set and the core is ready; it
clears when `stpl_enable` goes from 0 to 1.

Bank `jesd204b_rx`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `control` | `0x0000` | 9 | rw | See the fields below. Reset `0x0`. |
| `status` | `0x0004` | 16 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `stpl_enable` | `0x0008` | 1 | rw | 1: the STPL generator (TX) or checker (RX) replaces the converter port. Reset `0x0`. |
| `stpl_errors` | `0x000c` | 32 | ro | STPL test errors: link clocks with mismatching samples while STPL is enabled and the core ready, cleared when STPL is enabled (``RX only``). |
| `lmfc` | `0x0010` | 4 | rw | LMFC reload value on SYSREF rising edge. Reset `0xb`. |
| `skew_levels` | `0x0014` | 32 | ro | Per-lane Skew FIFO levels, 8-bit per lane, lane0 in bits [7:0] (``RX only``). |
| `skew_overflows` | `0x0018` | 8 | ro | Per-lane sticky Skew FIFO overflow flags, cleared on link resync (``RX only``). |
| `lane_align` | `0x001c` | 16 | ro | Per-lane byte alignment in bits [7:0] (2-bit per lane) and sticky realign flags in bits [11:8], cleared on link resync (``RX only``). |

Fields of `control`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `enable` | 0 | 1: links out of reset, the core runs. 0: links held in reset. |
| `ilas_check_` `disable` | 8 | 1: the RX links accept an ILAS that differs from the expected one. No effect on a TX core. |

Fields of `status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `ready` | 0 | 1: every link of the core is synchronized and carries data. |
| `sync_n` | 1 | JESD ``SYNC~`` status. |
| `skew_fifo` | 15:8 | JESD Skew FIFO level (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |

## JESD204C TX control {#reg-jesd204c-tx}

Defined by `LiteJESD204CCoreControl` (`litejesd204/core_204c.py`).

One `LiteJESD204CCoreControl` per core. A TX control creates the same registers as an
RX control; `skew_fifo`, `lane_status`, `crc_errors`, `emb_debug` and `stpl_errors`
are not driven on TX and read 0. The reset value of `lmfc` is the LEMC load, 5 on TX.

Bank `jesd204c_tx`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `control` | `0x0000` | 1 | rw | 1: links out of reset, the core runs. 0: links held in reset. Reset `0x0`. |
| `status` | `0x0004` | 16 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `stpl_enable` | `0x0008` | 1 | rw | 1: the STPL generator (TX) or checker (RX) replaces the converter port. Reset `0x0`. |
| `stpl_errors` | `0x000c` | 32 | ro | STPL test errors: link clocks with mismatching samples while STPL is enabled and the core ready, cleared when STPL is enabled (``RX only``). |
| `lmfc` | `0x0010` | 5 | rw | LEMC reload value on SYSREF rising edge. Reset `0x5`. |
| `lane_status` | `0x0014` | 16 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `crc_errors` | `0x0018` | 32 | ro | Accumulated CRC-12 errors, all lanes (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |
| `emb_debug` | `0x001c` | 16 | ro | See the fields below. |

Fields of `status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `ready` | 0 | 1: every link of the core is synchronized and carries data. |
| `skew_fifo` | 15:8 | JESD Skew FIFO level (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |

Fields of `lane_status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `sh_lock` | 7:0 | Per-lane sync header lock (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |
| `emb_lock` | 15:8 | Per-lane extended multiblock lock (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |

Fields of `emb_debug`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `state` | 7:0 | EMB FSM state of lanes 0-3, 2-bit per lane: 0=INIT, 1=HUNT, 2=LOCK (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |
| `eomb_seen` | 15:8 | Per-lane sticky EoMB-detected flag (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |

## JESD204C RX control {#reg-jesd204c-rx}

Defined by `LiteJESD204CCoreControl` (`litejesd204/core_204c.py`).

`lane_status` and `crc_errors` cover lanes 0 to 7, `emb_debug` lanes 0 to 3.
`crc_errors` adds the CRC-12 errors of every lane; software cannot clear it. Both
32-bit counters cross to the system clock with a `BusSynchronizer` handshake. The
reset value of `lmfc` is the RX LEMC load, `lemc_cycles - 5`: 27 here, with E=1.
`stpl_errors` behaves as on a JESD204B RX core.

Bank `jesd204c_rx`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `control` | `0x0000` | 1 | rw | 1: links out of reset, the core runs. 0: links held in reset. Reset `0x0`. |
| `status` | `0x0004` | 16 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `stpl_enable` | `0x0008` | 1 | rw | 1: the STPL generator (TX) or checker (RX) replaces the converter port. Reset `0x0`. |
| `stpl_errors` | `0x000c` | 32 | ro | STPL test errors: link clocks with mismatching samples while STPL is enabled and the core ready, cleared when STPL is enabled (``RX only``). |
| `lmfc` | `0x0010` | 5 | rw | LEMC reload value on SYSREF rising edge. Reset `0x1b`. |
| `lane_status` | `0x0014` | 16 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `crc_errors` | `0x0018` | 32 | ro | Accumulated CRC-12 errors, all lanes (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |
| `emb_debug` | `0x001c` | 16 | ro | See the fields below. |

Fields of `status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `ready` | 0 | 1: every link of the core is synchronized and carries data. |
| `skew_fifo` | 15:8 | JESD Skew FIFO level (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |

Fields of `lane_status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `sh_lock` | 7:0 | Per-lane sync header lock (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |
| `emb_lock` | 15:8 | Per-lane extended multiblock lock (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |

Fields of `emb_debug`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `state` | 7:0 | EMB FSM state of lanes 0-3, 2-bit per lane: 0=INIT, 1=HUNT, 2=LOCK (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |
| `eomb_seen` | 15:8 | Per-lane sticky EoMB-detected flag (``RX only``, reads 0 on a TX core). |
